newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bond to gear down to 110-28,22 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bond to gear down to 110-28,22 support.

text.p: September T-bond futures will pull back towards support around 110-28,22 on Monday after hurtling through the top of the recent range on Friday, technical analysts said.

"We finally broke out of this pattern we had for so long," said Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking, here. "It's getting slightly overbought so I would look for some consolidation."
Ostwald put an initial downside target at 110-20.
By 1000 GMT, September T-bond futures were at 111-01, down 6/32 in automated trade.
On Friday, they soared from a low of 109-15, through the May 13 range top high, to a peak of 111-09 on weaker than expected jobs growth for May.
Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London, said the contract was likely to dip back under the 111-00 level, to 110-28/22 where there was support from hourly highs.
"The real acid test will be whether it can hold above 110-09," said Celaya. "There's not really any major support before there."
Ostwald said once the contract had consolidated it would aim to retest Friday's 111-09 high.
Once above there, it would push for 111-21, resistance from lows in early February.
Celaya also said the contract would need to retake Friday's high to clear the decks of most resistance. That would leave T-bonds a clear run to 112-00.
September Eurodollars were quoted at 94.035, down 0.025 in automated trade. December were quoted at 93.835, down 0.025. --Jacqueline Thorpe, International Bonds Unit +44 171 542 6176
